_note: Hand-created via the SDK as casey@ourresearch.org (scripts/monitoring_create_alert.py). Not a bundle resource: DABs alerts must be owned by the deploying identity (github-actions-deploy), which has no access to openalex.monitoring or the warehouse, and the bundle-level run_as (terraform_user) is rejected for alerts. Re-run the script to update.
query_text:
WITH night AS ( SELECT current_date() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AS d ), flagged AS ( SELECT component, check_id, dimension, status, value, CASE WHEN value = FLOOR(value) AND ABS(value) < 1e15 THEN CAST(CAST(value AS BIGINT) AS STRING) ELSE CAST(ROUND(value, 3) AS STRING) END AS v FROM openalex.monitoring.findings WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT d FROM night) AND status IN ('critical', 'watch') ), per_check AS ( -- one entry per check: "check value", "check[dim] value", or "check ×N (top dim value)" SELECT component, status, check_id, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX_BY(dimension, value) AS top_dim, MAX_BY(v, value) AS top_v FROM flagged GROUP BY component, status, check_id ), per_component AS ( SELECT component, status, concat_ws(' · ', sort_array(collect_list( CASE WHEN n = 1 AND top_dim IS NULL THEN concat(check_id, ' ', top_v) WHEN n = 1 THEN concat(check_id, '[', top_dim, '] ', top_v) ELSE concat(check_id, ' ×', n, ' (top ', top_dim, ' ', top_v, ')') END))) AS txt FROM per_check GROUP BY component, status ), lists AS ( SELECT status, concat_ws('
', sort_array(collect_list(concat(component, ': ', txt)))) AS txt FROM per_component GROUP BY status ), counts AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_checks, COUNT_IF(status = 'critical') AS n_critical, COUNT_IF(status = 'watch') AS n_watch, COUNT_IF(status NOT IN ('ok', 'critical', 'watch')) AS n_unscored FROM openalex.monitoring.findings WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT d FROM night) ) SELECT CAST(night.d AS STRING) AS report_date, COALESCE(counts.n_checks, 0) AS n_checks, COALESCE(counts.n_critical, 0) AS n_critical, COALESCE(counts.n_watch, 0) AS n_watch, COALESCE(counts.n_unscored, 0) AS n_unscored, COALESCE((SELECT txt FROM lists WHERE status = 'critical'), 'none') AS criticals, COALESCE((SELECT txt FROM lists WHERE status = 'watch'), 'none') AS watches, concat_ws(' ', COALESCE(r.anomalies, '(no report row for this night)'), CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.failures, 'none'))) NOT IN ('none', 'none.') THEN concat('Failures: ', r.failures) END, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.opportunities, 'none'))) NOT IN ('none', 'none.') THEN concat('Suggestion: ', r.opportunities) END ) AS narrative, concat(CAST(night.d AS STRING), ' · ', COALESCE(counts.n_critical, 0), ' critical, ', COALESCE(counts.n_watch, 0), ' watch — ', COALESCE(r.headline, 'no report')) AS subject FROM night CROSS JOIN counts LEFT JOIN openalex.monitoring.reports r ON r.report_date = night.d
